_comment: Catalog entries not yet built. Move an entry into .claude-plugin/marketplace.json only when its plugin directory exists and validates — every marketplace `source` must point at a directory containing .claude-plugin/plugin.json (invariant I8). Names/descriptions below are the canonical CP-catalog wording.

planned.name: bar-compliant-marketing-reviewer
planned.description: Reviews attorney marketing materials — websites, social posts, ads, email campaigns — against your state bar's advertising rules and flags non-compliant language before it goes live.

planned.name: ai-use-policy-generator
planned.description: Generates a tailored AI use policy for your firm covering client confidentiality, competence obligations, disclosure requirements, and acceptable-use guardrails — aligned to your jurisdiction's ethics rules.

planned.name: consult-prep-brief-generator
planned.description: Turns a prospective client intake form or email thread into a focused consultation brief: key facts, likely claims, jurisdiction notes, and the three questions most worth asking in the first meeting.

planned.name: demand-letter-drafter
planned.description: Drafts a practice-area-specific demand letter from your matter files: factual summary, legal basis, relief demanded, and response deadline. Requires attorney review before sending.

planned.name: estate-planning-assembly
planned.description: Assembles a first-draft estate planning document set — will, durable power of attorney, healthcare directive — from a completed intake questionnaire. All drafts require attorney review before execution.

planned.name: immigration-filing-drafter
planned.description: Drafts cover letters, personal statements, and supporting narratives for common immigration filings from your client intake notes. Attorney review required before submission.

planned.name: spanish-intake-skill
planned.description: Conducts a bilingual (English/Spanish) client intake, produces a structured intake summary in English for the attorney's file, and drafts a Spanish-language acknowledgment for the client.

planned.name: ai-tool-hygiene-audit
planned.description: Audits your firm's current AI tool usage against bar ethics rules — confidentiality, competence, supervision, and disclosure — and produces a prioritized remediation checklist.
